data.narrative:
Frankenburg Technologies is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Taavi Madiberk and Marko Virkebau that has raised €40M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprised of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The comparable set spans valuations from $125M to $3.0B, with a median of $1.0B. Named peers within this cohort include Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B, Series B), Code Metal ($1.2B, Series B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B, Series B). This peer clustering at and above the $1.0B mark reflects robust investor appetite for Defense & Security frontier-tech at the Series B stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. This implies Frankenburg's post-money valuation would sit at the lower quartile of the peer set, consistent with its earlier-stage positioning relative to Series B comparables. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation, customer traction relative to named peers, and near-term funding trajectory. The range carries reliance on a single methodological anchor; revenue or customer data would strengthen conviction.
